description: Complete Legal Metrology (Packaged Commodities) Rules, 2011 Knowledge Base covering Rules 1-34 and First through Seventh Schedules.

rules.name: Short title and commencement
rules.description: These rules may be called the Legal Metrology (Packaged Commodities) Rules, 2011 and came into force on the 1st day of April, 2011.

rules.name: Statutory definitions
rules.description: Statutory definitions of pre-packaged commodity, dealer, industrial consumer, institutional consumer, manufacturer, packer, principal display panel, and retail package.

rules.name: Application of Chapter II to retail packages
rules.description: The provisions of Chapter II apply to packages intended for retail sale, except as otherwise provided in Rules 24, 25, and 26.
rules.message_pass: Product is subject to Chapter II retail package provisions.
rules.message_fail: Product is non-retail (e.g. bulk wholesale, export, industrial).

rules.name: Regulation for pre-packing and sale in packaged form (multipack / combo pack)
rules.description: On a multi-piece or combination package, the number of individual packages and net quantity of each must be declared.

requirements.description: Net quantity of each individual pack declared

rules.message_pass: Multi-piece package declares individual package count and net quantity.
rules.message_fail: Multi-piece package does not declare individual package count or net quantity.

rules.name: Specific commodities to be packed in specified standard quantities
rules.description: Commodities specified in the Second Schedule shall be packed only in specified standard quantities unless permitted otherwise.
rules.message_pass: Pack size complies with Second Schedule standard pack sizes.
rules.message_fail: Pack size violates Second Schedule standard pack size requirements.

rules.name: Manufacturer / Packer / Importer name & address declared
rules.description: Every pre-packaged commodity must declare the name and address of the manufacturer, or packer, or importer.

exemptions.description: Product falls under a whole-of-declaration exemption.

rules.message_pass: Manufacturer/packer/importer name and address is declared.
rules.message_fail: Manufacturer/packer/importer name and address is missing from the label.
rules.message_uncertain: Could not confirm presence of the manufacturer/packer/importer declaration from the available evidence.

rules.name: Common / generic name of commodity declared
rules.description: Every package must declare the common or generic name of the commodity.
rules.message_pass: Common/generic name of commodity is declared.
rules.message_fail: Common/generic name of commodity is missing from the label.

rules.name: Net quantity declared
rules.description: Net quantity in standard unit of weight, measure or number must be declared.

requirements.description: Net quantity carries a standard unit of weight/volume/count

rules.message_pass: Net quantity and unit are declared.
rules.message_fail: Net quantity or unit is missing from the label.

rules.name: Month & year of manufacture / packing declared
rules.description: The month and year in which the commodity is manufactured or pre-packed or imported must be declared.
rules.message_pass: Month and year of manufacture/packing is declared.
rules.message_fail: Month and year of manufacture/packing is missing from the label.

rules.name: Best before / use by / expiry date declared where required
rules.description: For packages containing commodities which may become unfit for human consumption, best before or expiry date must be declared.
rules.message_pass: Best before / expiry date is declared.
rules.message_fail: Best before / expiry date is missing from the label.
rules.message_not_applicable: This product's category is not one of the categories requiring best-before/expiry date.

rules.name: Maximum Retail Price (MRP), inclusive of all taxes, declared
rules.description: The retail sale price (MRP inclusive of all taxes) must be declared on every retail package.
rules.message_pass: MRP is declared.
rules.message_fail: MRP is missing from the label.

rules.name: Consumer care contact details declared
rules.description: Name, address, telephone number, and e-mail of the consumer care cell must be declared.
rules.message_pass: Consumer care contact details declared.
rules.message_fail: Consumer care contact details missing from the label.

rules.name: Country of origin declared for imported commodities
rules.description: Country of origin or manufacture/assembly must be declared for imported pre-packaged commodities.
rules.message_pass: Country of origin is declared.
rules.message_fail: Country of origin is missing for imported product.
rules.message_not_applicable: Domestic product (not imported); country of origin declaration not mandatory.

rules.name: Declared unit sale price matches MRP / net-quantity within tolerance
rules.description: Where unit sale price is declared, it must be arithmetically consistent with MRP and net quantity within rounding tolerance.

derived.name: unit_price_deviation_pct
derived.description: Percentage deviation of declared unit price from expected.

rules.message_pass: Declared unit sale price is within +/-5% tolerance.
rules.message_fail: Declared unit sale price deviates by more than 5% from expected.
rules.message_uncertain: Could not compute expected unit sale price from evidence.

rules.name: Numeral & letter height meets minimum mm requirements for PDP area
rules.description: Height of numerals and letters declaring quantity on PDP must satisfy Seventh Schedule minimums.
rules.message_pass: Numeral height meets or exceeds Seventh Schedule threshold.
rules.message_fail: Numeral height is below Seventh Schedule threshold.

rules.name: Mandatory declarations grouped on Principal Display Panel
rules.description: All mandatory declarations must be displayed prominently on the Principal Display Panel.
rules.message_pass: Mandatory declarations are located on the Principal Display Panel.

rules.name: Complete address declared for manufacturer / packer
rules.description: Name and address must state street, city, state and postal pin code per Rule 10.

rules.name: Manner of declaration of quantity
rules.description: Quantity must be declared in standard terms: mass for solid, volume for liquid, count for number.

rules.name: Statement of units conforms to Third Schedule standard symbols
rules.description: Unit symbols must conform to standard SI symbols (g, kg, mg, ml, l, m, cm, mm, number) without non-standard symbols like gms or kgs.
rules.message_pass: Declared unit symbol complies with Third Schedule statutory standard.
rules.message_fail: Declared unit symbol violates Third Schedule (e.g. non-standard gms, kgs, ltr).

rules.name: Prohibition on alteration of price or selling above MRP
rules.description: No dealer, wholesale or retail, shall alter, obliterate or smudge the declared MRP, nor sell at a price higher than the declared retail sale price.

rules.name: Inspection powers of Legal Metrology Officers
rules.description: Statutory power of Director, Controller and Legal Metrology Officers to inspect premises and test packages.

rules.name: Action on completion of inspection
rules.description: Procedure for seizure, sample drawing, and testing report upon completion of inspection.

rules.name: Net quantity complies with First Schedule Maximum Permissible Error (MPE)
rules.description: The net quantity deficiency of any package shall not exceed the Maximum Permissible Error specified in the First Schedule.
rules.message_pass: Net quantity error is within First Schedule maximum permissible error limits.
rules.message_fail: Net quantity error exceeds First Schedule maximum permissible error limits.

rules.name: Declarations on wholesale packages
rules.description: Wholesale packages must declare name and address of manufacturer/packer, net quantity, and wholesale price.

rules.name: Exemption for export packages
rules.description: Packages meant for export are exempt from Chapter II retail declaration rules.
rules.message_pass: Export package: exempt from domestic retail labeling rules.

rules.name: Exemption for small packages (net weight/measure <= 10g or 10ml)
rules.description: Packages containing net weight or measure of 10g/10ml or less (except tobacco) are exempt from Chapter II declarations.
rules.message_pass: Small package (<=10g/ml): qualifies for statutory exemption under Rule 26(a).

rules.name: Exemption for fast food items packed by restaurants or hotels
rules.description: Fast food items prepared and served by a hotel or restaurant are exempt from Chapter II declarations.
rules.message_pass: Restaurant/hotel fast food pack: exempt from domestic retail labeling rules.
rules.message_not_applicable: Not sold by a restaurant or hotel; exemption does not apply.

rules.name: Exemption for scheduled drug formulations
rules.description: Scheduled formulations under Drugs (Prices Control) Order or Drugs & Cosmetics Rules are exempt from specific LMPC provisions.
rules.message_pass: Scheduled drug: exempt from standard LMPC declarations.
rules.message_not_applicable: Not a scheduled drug; exemption does not apply.

rules.name: Exemption for agricultural produce packages > 50 kg
rules.description: Agricultural produce in packages exceeding 50 kg is exempt from retail declarations.

rules.name: Exemption for industrial and institutional consumers
rules.description: Packages meant for direct consumption by industrial consumers (manufacturing use) or institutional consumers (transport/hotel/hospital direct use) are exempt from retail declarations.

rules.name: Manufacturer / Packer / Importer registration obligation
rules.description: Every manufacturer, packer, or importer of pre-packaged commodities must be registered with the Director or Controller.
rules.message_pass: Actor holds valid LMPC registration certificate.
rules.message_fail: Actor role requires LMPC registration, but no certificate is held.
rules.message_not_applicable: Actor role does not require registration under Rule 27.

rules.name: Application for registration under Rule 27
rules.description: Procedural requirements for submitting application for registration in Form 1.

rules.name: Maintenance of records and registers
rules.description: Obligation of manufacturers and packers to maintain production, packing and testing records.

rules.name: Compilation of lists of registered manufacturers and packers
rules.description: Administrative obligation of the Director or Controller to compile and publish lists of registered manufacturers and packers.

rules.name: Mandatory declarations on advertisement of pre-packaged commodities
rules.description: Every advertisement in digital, e-commerce, or print media must declare the retail sale price and net quantity.

requirements.description: Retail sale price is declared on the advertisement
Net quantity is declared on the advertisement

rules.message_pass: Advertisement declares retail price and net quantity.
rules.message_fail: Advertisement fails to declare retail price or net quantity.
rules.message_not_applicable: Label inspection context (not an advertisement); Rule 31 does not apply.

rules.name: Penalty for contravention of rules
rules.description: Whoever contravenes any provision of these rules shall be punished with fine in accordance with the Legal Metrology Act.

rules.name: Power of Central Government to relax rules
rules.description: The Central Government may, after consultation with the Director, relax any provision of these rules for reasons recorded in writing.

rules.name: Repeal and savings
rules.description: The Standards of Weights and Measures (Packaged Commodities) Rules, 1977 are hereby repealed without affecting prior operations.
